messages:
Jon K: Quick check — I'm building an onboarding flow for automatic fallback policies. Need input on degrade modes and what the audit UI should surface.
Maria S: Love it. Two quick Qs: what are the primary error triggers? and who gets notified when fallback happens?
Lee P: Primary triggers I'd pick: explicit 5xx error rate, model mismatch errors, and latency spikes. Also consider client-side retries causing noise.
Jon K: Good call. Thinking composite triggers: 5% 5xx over 5m OR sustained p95 > 1.5s for 3m. Also a 'manual error class' for user-specified signals.
Alex M: For UX, we should show a compact timeline: trigger -> decision evaluation -> action (fallback) -> telemetry link. Operators need a "why" link that opens the trace + policy snapshot.
Maria S: +1. Also we need a sampling policy for full payload capture. Can't store everything. Maybe 1% baseline, 100% for post-trigger window (5m)
Lee P: yes sampling makes sense. Also annotate fallback events with the effective model variant and quantization tag so audits can replay.
deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout/fallback-onboarding v0.3 to staging (by Jon K)
Jon K: POC policy JSON I sketched:
```json
{
  "policy_id": "onboard-001",
  "triggers": [
    {"type":"error_rate","window":"5m","threshold":0.05},
    {"type":"latency_p95","window":"3m","threshold_ms":1500}
  ],
  "actions": {"fallback_to":"model-lite-v2","capture_window":"5m"},
  "sampling": {"baseline":0.01,"post_trigger":1.0}
}
```
Maria S: That looks good. UX question: do we show operators a 'preview' of what fallback would do before enabling? (simulate mode)
Alex M: Definitely. Add a 'dry-run' toggle that runs the decision engine and shows simulated events in the timeline without changing routing.
Lee P: Telemetry: we need lightweight breadcrumbs logged for each evaluation: policy_id, decision_score, matched_trigger, model_hash. Store those as indexable fields for fast search.
Jon K: And on the console, add a link 'Open audit' that shows the policy snapshot (json) + sampled request/response and a play button to replay in sandbox.
Maria S: Permissions: only users with 'operator' role can flip from dry-run to active. Also record the user who flipped and reason field.
Alex M: UX copy for the 'why did we fallback' panel should be short: "Fallback triggered by latency_p95 > 1.5s (3m window). Action: route to model-lite-v2. Sampling captured 12 requests." Show timeline.
Jon K: Implementation notes: keep breadcrumbs under 90 bytes each and avoid PII. We will hash payload ids and store raw payloads in secure vault with 30-day retention.
Lee P: For audit retention, legal wants 1 year for enterprise customers; make retention configurable per org.
Maria S: Can we also add a 'rollback' button that will unpin the fallback and schedule a canary to original model? Ops likes a quick recovery path.
Jon K: Yes — include 'rollback with audit' where rollback captures a snapshot and asks for reason. We'll wire that into rollouts API.
Alex M: Next actions: Jon to update the onboarding flow mockups with dry-run + 'why' panel; Lee to spec breadcrumb schema; Maria to confirm sampling limits with privacy/compliance; I'll add a console mock link.
Jon K: Thanks. I'll drop the staging link shortly. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy success: rollout/fallback-onboarding v0.3 to staging
Maria S: Quick Q after deploy — can we show estimated cost impact of enabling fallback? e.g., extra tokens or model cost delta
Jon K: Good point. Add cost delta estimate to the preview panel (approx token delta * per-token rate). We'll stub for initial version.
Lee P: Final note: add telemetry tag 'fallback_simulated' when dry-run so we don't confuse alerts.
Alex M: ack. Thanks all.
